## Agreement of MAGUS's L-INS-i backbones with each second aligner (cross-subset pairs)

overlap = fraction of L-INS-i pairs the tool also aligns (mean over the 10 backbones; reference-free). support = bbevidence's support of the unconfirmed pairs (reference-free). prec_* use the reference (diagnostic only): precision of all / confirmed / unconfirmed L-INS-i pairs and of the tool's own pairs. s/bb = mean seconds per backbone (4 backbones in parallel, 4 MAFFT threads each).
